name: verify_productBaseUnit_audit_columns_by_id
note: product_base_unit: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM product_base_unit ORDER BY id

name: verify_productBaseUnit_rows_per_create_uid
note: product_base_unit: record count per creating user (the 'created by' grouping of the list view)
source_sql: SELECT create_uid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_base_unit GROUP BY create_uid ORDER BY create_uid
